planned_claim: Recursive training can amplify error or erode low-probability behavior in studied workflows
required_evidence: Reviewed primary literature with exact locations
allowed_wording: Prior work reports degradation in specified recursive settings; outcomes depend on workflow and distribution.
failure_consequence: Remove universal language and name the specific settings not supported.

planned_claim: Accumulation, real-data mixing, verification, or selection can stabilize some workflows
required_evidence: Primary papers for each named intervention
allowed_wording: Prior work shows stabilization in particular protocols.
failure_consequence: Delete unsupported intervention or narrow to the audited source.

planned_claim: The project has a narrow provisional distinction
required_evidence: Saturated primary-source search plus qualified external hostile review
allowed_wording: The provisional distinction is the full conjunction of recursion, lifetime human-token accounting, time allocation, mode allocation, and matched non-joint baselines.
failure_consequence: Withdraw novelty wording and position as replication, transfer, or controlled comparison.

planned_claim: Four policy families are compared at matched human and total token budgets
required_evidence: Frozen configs, token-accounting tests, validated manifests
allowed_wording: We will compare fresh-random, schedule-only, selection-only, and joint policies under matched budgets.
failure_consequence: Do not interpret efficacy; invalidate any unmatched contrast.

planned_claim: Joint allocation improves the primary outcome
required_evidence: Valid completed paired chains, frozen estimand, effect threshold, uncertainty, and artifact hashes
allowed_wording: Under the frozen setting, the joint policy improved the preregistered outcome relative to the strongest eligible non-joint baseline.
failure_consequence: Use tie, harm, uncertainty, or invalidity wording instead.

planned_claim: Joint and strongest non-joint policies are practically equivalent
required_evidence: Valid paired interval contained in the frozen equivalence region
allowed_wording: The joint policy provided no practically meaningful advantage in this setting.
failure_consequence: Do not call a nonsignificant or imprecise result equivalent.

planned_claim: Joint allocation is harmful or less stable
required_evidence: Valid paired outcome in harmful region or frozen stability failure
allowed_wording: Joint adaptation worsened the preregistered outcome or stability criterion in this setting.
failure_consequence: Do not soften harm into a null result; report affected outcomes.

required_evidence: Valid interval spanning beneficial, equivalent, or harmful regions
allowed_wording: The experiment is too imprecise to distinguish the prespecified regions.
failure_consequence: Do not claim no effect or practical equivalence.

planned_claim: Omitting an important monitored mode reduces or reverses targeting benefit
required_evidence: Predeclared omission intervention with untouched full evaluation and valid budgets
allowed_wording: The preregistered omission caused targeted allocation to lose benefit or cause harm on untouched evaluation.
failure_consequence: Report no detected boundary, uncertainty, or invalidity; do not generalize.

planned_claim: The omission test does not detect the predicted boundary
required_evidence: Valid intervention and interval excluding the frozen harmful boundary
allowed_wording: This omission intervention did not detect the prespecified failure boundary.
failure_consequence: Do not claim robustness to all monitor misspecification.

planned_claim: Under-covered modes have greater marginal value for human anchors
required_evidence: Mechanism intervention or theory plus valid experiment
allowed_wording: We hypothesize that under-covered modes may have greater marginal value.
failure_consequence: Keep as hypothesis or remove; never describe the mechanism as established.

planned_claim: Human-origin token budgets are exact and equal
required_evidence: Batch-level accounting records, resume checks, policy comparisons, manifest validation
allowed_wording: Policies are designed to match lifetime human-origin optimizer-token exposure.
failure_consequence: Budget mismatch invalidates the efficacy comparison.

planned_claim: Final-test data did not influence policies or tuning
required_evidence: Five disjoint manifests, overlap report, access audit, frozen hashes
allowed_wording: Final-test data are reserved from prompting, selection, tuning, and early stopping.
failure_consequence: Leakage invalidates affected results and requires a new untouched test partition.

required_evidence: Two official arms, frozen tolerance, rerun, complete artifacts
allowed_wording: The novel pilot remains blocked until the positive control passes or its failure is scientifically resolved.
failure_consequence: Do not run or interpret the novel treatment as validated.

required_evidence: Immutable run manifests, code/config hashes, exact analysis command, generated output hashes
allowed_wording: All reported values are generated from validated immutable chain artifacts.
failure_consequence: Remove values lacking provenance and mark the analysis invalid.

planned_claim: Any favorable effect is limited to the frozen pilot scope
required_evidence: Valid experiment plus recorded model, domain, horizon, budget, seeds, and limitations
allowed_wording: The finding applies to the frozen domain, model, horizon, and budget.
failure_consequence: Do not claim broad collapse prevention, optimality, or frontier-scale transfer.
